content.thinking: The test_qp module runs the loop at import. Let me guard the test loop with `if __name__ == '__main__'`.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='tests/test_qp.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("fails = 0\ntot = 0\nfor seed in range(600):", "def main():\n  fails = 0\n  tot = 0\n  for seed in range(600):")
# indent the rest
lines=s.split('\n')
out=[]
started=False
for ln in lines:
    if ln.startswith('def main():'):
        started=True
        out.append(ln)
        continue
    if started and ln.strip() and not ln.startswith('  for seed'):
        out.append('  '+ln)
    else:
        out.append(ln)
s='\n'.join(out)
s+="""
if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
"""
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
tail -30 /workspace/tests/test_qp.py
